name: opencode
doc: opencode: free models (opencode/*-free), OpenCode Go subscription (opencode-go/*), OpenRouter (openrouter/* :free ids only unless the account has credits). --standalone keeps the run in our process group (the background service keeps ghost sessions alive otherwise). Accounts: XDG_DATA_HOME selects the data directory that holds opencode's auth.json (~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json), so a second account lives in ~/.local/share-b (standard <default>-<letter>); config (~/.config/opencode) stays shared.

usage.note: limits only in the interactive /usage; the reset time in the quota error is parsed by run-model
